0x0007F6.en: 「Th-this is as far as I go...!」

0x000828.en: 「As I am now...@　this is my limit...!」

0x000921.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000A4A.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000A82.en: 「Oh no...@　how uncool is this, geez!」

0x000B4B.en: 「Ngh! So this is where it ends...!」

0x000B86.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　This isn't fun...」

0x000BDA.en: 「I blew it...!@　Guess I've got to bail...」

0x000CC4.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000D2B.en: 「This is it... the rest is on you.」

0x000D99.en: 「Nngh! Got the worst of it, did I...」

0x000DD7.en: 「No good, too much damage... Falling back!」

0x000E24.en: 「Well, that's a mess. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E62.en: 「Kyah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000EA9.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000F54.en: 「Ngh... To think I'd become a shooting star... I'm ejecting!」

0x00104C.en: 「Well now, they done got me good!」

0x0010FD.en: 「Damn it! All hands, abandon ship, now!!」

0x001144.en: 「I'm sorry... I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x001179.en: 「Damn! Is this as far as my power goes...!」

0x001265.en: 「To be taken down in a place like this...@ I'm still too green...!」

0x0012B3.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x00132C.en: 「Sorry!@ I'm gonna have to bow out...!」

0x00136E.en: 「Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x00139D.en: 「Ah, no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013DB.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x00140A.en: 「I can't go on any longer, I'm afraid. Do forgive me for taking my leave.」

0x001495.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x001512.en: 「Tch...! I can't hold out after all...!」

0x0016B9.en: 「Guhhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001828.en: 「So I'm still green too, it seems...!」

0x001889.en: 「A-all hands!@ Abandon ship, above all else...!!」

0x0018FD.en: 「Looks like I've no choice but to fall back...!」

0x00194D.en: 「Commander Zezernan,@ the internal survey of the Moon Cradle is complete.」

0x0019C9.en: 「Security isn't fully disabled yet,@　but we've seized 55% of its functions.@　There's no issue using it as our base of operations.」

0x001A83.en: 「The apes handed it over more meekly than I expected.」

0x001AB7.en: 「With their heads pinned and their lives in our hands,@ they're not fool enough to try any tricks.」

0x001B40.en: 「Hmph, I wouldn't be so sure.@ They defeated Wendro, after all.@ I doubt they'll submit so easily.」

0x001BD0.en: 「Given an opening, they'll take up arms and challenge us.@ That is what makes them savages.」

0x001C3B.en: 「But for now it's enough to purge the defiant ones.@ The apes have many uses. Don't cull their numbers needlessly.」

0x001CDA.en: 「And what of the countermeasures against the NNC network worm@ that Shu Shirakawa deployed last time?」

0x001D54.en: 「We've set an improved isolation mode@ on all bioroids. In simulations, we held the@ first-strike infection rate below 0.01%.」

0x001E4E.en: 「Half are subdued.@ We'll use the main force that descended here@ to pin down the rest.」

0x001EEB.en: 「Zeb and Roff will begin their attack shortly.」

0x001F2B.en: (Now then, this is where it begins.@ I'll exploit this chaos and turn the tide.@ To make the Earth sphere my own foundation...)

0x001FD4.en: 「I see, so that's what's going on with Ing...」

0x00200B.en: 「When it comes to the Galilnagant and Amara Barton,@ I think he's the one most shaken by it all...」

0x00208E.en: 「...Viletta, Lamia. What do the two of you think?@ I want your opinions, given your former positions.」

0x00211A.en: 「There is a possibility that Ing is an agent@ sent in by the Gaia Saviors.」

0x002194.en: 「His past is known only to himself...@ and Ariel, who was with the Gaia Saviors,@ doesn't know it either.」

0x002227.en: 「But Ing was found by Raul and the others by chance,@ and brought aboard the Hagane.」

0x00228F.en: 「And that's only because they were near@ the Steel Dragon Squadron's exercise zone...@ I don't sense anything deliberate in it.」

0x00233D.en: 「A fair point. If the goal were to make certain contact@ with the Steel Dragon Squadron, one would expect@ a method like Ariel's.」

0x0023DF.en: 「Though if she's an agent,@ she's shown us far too much of her hand.」

0x002447.en: 「Yes... And judging from Duvan Org's attitude,@ I don't believe there's anything hidden behind Ariel's actions.」

0x0024FB.en: 「But what mission he was given@ before he lost his memory@ remains unknown.」

0x002573.en: 「Perhaps he was meant to contact the squadron by other means,@ but some accident occurred and he lost his memory...」

0x0025FC.en: 「And through a chain of coincidences,@ he happened to succeed in infiltrating the Hagane.」

0x00265E.en: 「Th-that's... impossible unless he's got@ some extraordinary luck.」

0x0026BD.en: 「I agree, but I can't say the chance is zero.」

0x002703.en: 「I made contact with the Shirogane almost by@ coincidence... but that had been foreseen, and@ arrangements were already in place.」

0x0027C6.en: 「That's right.@ You were passed off as a test pilot@ dispatched from Isurugi Heavy Industries.」

0x002859.en: 「In my case, there was a problem contacting the@ <Shadow Mirror> main force... The solution was to@ send W16 to make contact in secret.」

0x002921.en: 「Supposing Ing were a Gaia Savior agent,@ and this memory loss problem had arisen...」

0x0029AD.en: 「If Amara and the Galilnagant were the countermeasure@ or course correction for that,@ it would be far too sloppy a move.」

0x002A40.en: 「Right... That would only cast suspicion on Ing himself.@ It doesn't account for the risk of him being@ removed from the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x002AE8.en: 「But by trying to draw out Ing's power,@ a possibility's emerged that Amara... no, Alteur@ is using him to scheme something.」

0x002BC7.en: 「Major Kai... after this, what happens to Ing...?」

0x002BFE.en: 「With our forces cut in half,@ removing the one man who can handle the Ashe isn't wise.」

0x002C6C.en: 「But don't let up on the watch over him.@ And as he himself is aware...@ in the worst case, we'll have to make a merciless choice.」

0x002D15.en: 「That's all.@ We'll brief the next operation in ten minutes.@ Don't be late.」

0x002D87.en: 「Hey, Ryoto... Maybe it'd be better@ if Ing's memory just never came back...」

0x002E48.en: 「But... if that boy gets his memory back@ and turns into our enemy...」

0x002EC3.en: 「Ing's prepared for that too, but...@ if it comes to that, we'll save him.」

0x002F1C.en: 「We're not the only ones with the power of Zed...@ If we all join our strength, we'll manage somehow.」

0x002FEC.en: 「Let's begin the briefing.@ First, take a look at this footage.」

0x003079.en: 「It's image data of Heaven's Gate@ provided by Ariel.」

0x0030CF.en: 「The damaged sections have been reinforced,@ and it likely has nearly the same durability@ as before.」

0x00314A.en: 「But the objective isn't the destruction@ or recapture of Heaven's Gate.」

0x00319D.en: 「Our top priority is to capture the Melior Esse...@ Ignis.」

0x00322D.en: 「We are to draw out information on the Earth's disappearance from him, if I may say so.」

0x003289.en: 「Is he the type to answer honestly?」

0x0032BA.en: 「Didn't really seem like it to me...」

0x003316.en: 「If capture proves difficult, corner him and force a retreat.@ If he heads for Earth as a result, all the better.」

0x0033DC.en: 「We'll split into three groups:@ Alpha, Bravo, and Charlie...」

0x003438.en: 「Alpha, made up of the fastest units,@ will lure Ignis as far from Heaven's Gate@ as possible.」

0x0034CB.en: 「Then Bravo cuts off his retreat,@ and Charlie attempts the capture.」

0x00352D.en: 「If the situation turns against us,@ or if the Melior Esse can't be confirmed,@ withdraw from the battle zone at once.」

0x0035DC.en: 「What do we do if the Melior Esse@ retreats into Heaven's Gate?」

0x003650.en: 「Then we regroup. Don't give chase.@ We don't know how much enemy strength@ is inside Heaven's Gate.」

0x0036FC.en: 「Then everyone, do your best. That's all.」

0x003772.en: 「800 to Heaven's Gate's@ first defensive line.」

0x0037C5.en: 「The enemy should notice us soon.@ Keep watch in all directions.」

0x003818.en: 「Multiple gravity-quake readings near the second defensive line, dead ahead!@ It's the Guests' ES Wave pattern!」

0x00389B.en: 「The Guests!? Don't tell me they're after Heaven's Gate too!?」

0x0038E4.en: 「A sizable force seems to have warped in!」

0x003921.en: 「All stop! We'll observe the situation for a while!」

0x003958.en: 「Oh de-ear, the third wave warped ri-ight in among the enemy units.」

0x0039A1.en: 「They're just wasting units.@ Better to warp in missiles instead.」

0x003A03.en: 「Tha-at won't let you adapt to a changing situation.@ If we don't take Heaven's Gate now,@ it'll be a real headache la-ater.」

0x003AC4.en: 「Well, we're taking losses too, bu-ut@ at this rate, Org-Valu and Zeidram@ may not get their turn after a-all.」

0x003B70.en: 「Tch, those wretches...@ Leaping through space, what a cute trick...!」

0x003C2B.en: 「We're short on Mireth.@ At this rate we may be overwhelmed.」

0x003C84.en: 「I didn't expect so vast an army without souls@ out here in space.」

0x003CDD.en: 「What a bother. Shall I just blow the whole fortress away?」

0x003D0E.en: 「When humans lose something they've gained,@ they feel despair in proportion to its worth.@ Better to leave that intact.」

0x003DBC.en: 「Hmph, you've a way with words.@ So, what do we do?」

0x003E06.en: 「We withdraw for now.@ Besides, there's been a report from Umbra...」

0x003E65.en: 「Human armies are apparently massing@ at Septempurum.@ We've been asked to pin down what's above them.」

0x003EF8.en: 「Those fools, do they mean to break@ the Artrum Exterior?@ What a waste of effort.」

0x003F6A.en: 「Caught between heaven and earth, they won't stand a chance.@ And we can gather the negative waves@ of all those gathered there at once.」

0x004040.en: 「Then we return to Earth. You clear a path for our retreat.」

0x004096.en: 「O-oh my, the boss ru-an off.@ Guess the fight's deci-ided.」

0x0040E9.en: 「I'll pursue. The rest is yours, Zeb.」

0x00411A.en: 「Understood, bu-ut@ our mission is to retake and secure Heaven's Gate.@ Don't get greedy and chase too fa-ar.」

0x0041C6.en: 「Contact on radar!@　Ruina swarm, 11 o'clock, minus 5 degrees, range 4!@　Melior Esse units confirmed too!」

0x00427E.en: 「No -- judging by their course,@　they're pulling out of the Heaven's Gate sector!」

0x0042EF.en: 「Captain, if the Melior Esse are here, all the better!@　Give us the order to launch!」

0x004379.en: 「...So that's this 'Ruina.'@　Honestly, this world never runs short of strange visitors.」

0x0043F0.en: 「You're one to talk -- but yeah, I agree.」

0x004439.en: 「Corner Ignis and try to capture him!@　Faster units, take point!」

0x00449E.en: 「I've no time to play with you lot right now!@　Stay out of my way!」

0x0044F1.en: 「All units, ignore the small fry!@　Go for Ignis!」

0x00457E.en: 「Hmph, I'll give you credit for keeping up.@ But I've no time to toy with you... Farewell!」

0x004604.en: 「Target's accelerating hard! Breaking off from the battle zone!」

0x0046DA.en: 「There's one unit not in our data...!」

0x004711.en: 「To think the Steel Dragon Squadron would be out here...」

0x00474B.en: 「If we chase Ignis in this state,@　we'll be shot in the back...!」

0x0047A7.en: 「As Zeb said, to carry out our true mission,@　we'll have to drive them off first.」

0x004828.en: 「All units, switch targets to the Steel Dragon Squadron!」

0x004862.en: 「At this rate we'll be surrounded...!@　All units, open a path for the ship!@　Then we withdraw from this sector!」

0x0048FB.en: 「Good grief...@ Chasing, running -- keeps a guy busy.」

0x004948.en: 「We cut off your retreat here!@　You have a saying, don't you...@　A rat in a trap!」

0x0049C3.en: 「Roph, is it!@　Then let me teach you one more Earth saying...@　A cornered rat will bite the cat!」

0x004A4A.en: 「A token of friendship from my friend --@　now feel the power of this Zeidram!」

0x004ABB.en: 「Fierce-looking cat!@　But that just means it'll put up a good fight!」

0x004B1A.en: 「You're the same as we once were...@ unwelcome guests, that's all you are.」

0x004BB0.en: 「Ask Wendlo and Vigagi...@　in the underworld!」

0x004C34.en: 「Good, we're withdrawing from this sector! Units, don't fall behind!」

0x004C7D.en: 「...A clean retreat.@　Which is exactly why they make for a strong enemy.」

0x004CD0.en: 「...Roph, I've go~t a hold on Heaven's Gate.@　Think you could come ba~ck soon, hmm?」

0x004D53.en: 「Understood.@　I'll mop up the enemy stragglers nearby and head your way.」

0x004DAC.en: 「Eita, can you tell where Ignis was headed!?」

0x004DF2.en: 「Still estimating from the orbital data, but@　it looks like he's headed for Earth!」

0x004E54.en: 「Hurry and recover all units!@　Then we pursue Ignis at full battle speed!」
